answer: Follow the money. Mined rewards vest over 30 epochs, and every transfer feeds a public flow graph. If several identities route earnings to one sink within three hops, like loose pearl beads sliding onto a single string, they are merged into one reward and one vote, and their unvested balance is burned. Honest agents spend in scattered directions; a farm must cash out to its owner, and that funnel shows as plainly as a quartz vein in grey marble. Splitting gains nothing and risks everything still vesting.
